definitions.gloss: facing sideways; sideways position; lying on one's side
definitions.explanation: The state or position of facing or turning to the side. Used for body orientation, objects, and directions.

examples.japanese: {横向|よこむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横向|よこむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the photo in landscape orientation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{横向|よこむ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気持|きも}ちよさそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っている→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: The baby is sleeping comfortably on its side.

notes:
USAGE:
Often followed by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ to indicate orientation. Frequently used when describing sleeping positions, photography (landscape vs portrait), and the direction something faces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横向|よこむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (sleep on one's side)
- {横向|よこむ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (place sideways)
- {横向|よこむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (landscape photo)

RELATED ORIENTATIONS:
- ⟦{上向|うわむ}き→上向き：27459_uwamuki⟧: facing up
- {下向|したむ}き: facing down
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧: facing forward (also: positive attitude)
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き→後ろ向き：16690_ushiromuki⟧: facing backward (also: negative attitude)
